name: MarkovModulate

args.name: nu
args.description: Controls the rate of switching between components.

args.name: method
args.description: `AlwaysSwitch` keeps the supplied switching rates; `MetropolisSwitching` can preserve component and character frequencies by reducing switching rates.

description: Constructs a Markov-modulated model that switches between components of a mixture at a rate controlled by `nu`. The switching methods coincide when component equilibrium frequencies are equal. With different frequencies, `AlwaysSwitch` can require a rooted tree even when the input models are reversible.
